summary: Updates a material requirements document header.
description:
Updates header fields such as title, notes, and status on the material requirements document.
Use status transitions to move the document through its workflow states.

schema.description: Class representing a procore response with data.
Represents a request to update header fields for a document that requires a header patch operation.

properties_to_add.description: Collection of resource parameters to add to the document header.

- TEXT: Any string
- BOOLEAN: "true" / "false"
- DATE: "YYYY-MM-DD" (e.g. "2026-03-02"). Send null or "" to clear.
- NUMBER: Numeric string (e.g. "42", "3.14"). Stored as-is.

scope_end_at.description: End date and time for the scope. Clears header field if value is an empty string or "0001-01-01T00:00:00.0000000+00:00".
